stories.title: With primaries over, some members of the GOP are breaking with President Trump
stories.summary: Several Republicans in competitive races broke with President Trump on key agenda issues this week as voters continue to express concern about the economy and the war with Iran.

stories.title: Leon Bridges' new album 'Happiness Anytime' is about cultivating joy
stories.summary: On his new album, Leon Bridges teams up with members of the band Jungle, frees himself of genre constraints and creates music that cultivates joy.

stories.title: Soybean farmers hopeful for Xi's White House visit
stories.summary: As China's president visits the White House, the Asia Society is visiting South Dakota to get grassroots views on agriculture trade issues.

stories.title: How Micah Johnson went Major League Baseball player to fine artist
stories.summary: Talent and a special kind of passion landed Micah Johnson in Major League Baseball. When a mental health crisis pushed him out of the sport, he turned his drive to another field entirely: fine art.

stories.title: How unarmed 911 teams are reshaping public safety in nearly 100 cities
stories.summary: Programs that send mental health workers out to 911 calls instead of police have grown in recent years. But doing them right is a challenge.

stories.title: The Pacific is churning with hurricanes. The Atlantic is quiet. Blame El Niño
stories.summary: The Pacific Ocean has churned with hurricanes this year while the Atlantic has had none. The unusual seasons are likely driven by an especially powerful El Nino.
